lineage.note: Humboldt CSI's official product page identifies T-1000 S1 as T-1000 × T-1000; together with the S1 designation this is treated as a selfed S1 line.

aromas.note: No cultivar-wide aroma claim is added beyond the official source.

terpenes.note: No cultivar-specific lot terpene profile or COA is used for this S1 entry.

origin.note: The official page does not establish a sufficiently bounded creation location for this S1 line; no location is inferred.

history.text: Humboldt CSI describes T-1000 as a selection from its Old Family Purple hybrid and states that the T-1000 cut is now available in S1 feminized seed form.
history.note: The official page gives cultivar development context but not a precise dated release chronology.
